verdict.rationale: Discord's own blog documents Threads as a way to branch a conversation off a channel's main feed, and Private Threads are available to all servers. Threads are optional offshoots, though, so busy channels still have an unthreaded main feed rather than every conversation sitting under a named topic. Missing for 10: evidence that all conversations are structured under named topics (e.g., forum-style channels), catch-up tools such as thread lists or unread summaries, admin controls for enforcing threading, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can catch up on busy channels efficiently because every conversation is organized under a named topic or thread

citations.quote: A Thread is a quick way to branch a conversation off of a channel’s main feed without removing it from the channel itself.
Private Threads are now available for all servers!
